messages:
maria: Heads-up: found an orphan anchor in the runbook -> /runbooks/serving/runtime.md#autoscale-rules 404s in prod docs. Who owns this page? @docs-bot can you confirm last editor? :thinking_face:

docs-bot: Last edit: alice (alice@redwood) 2024-09-12
Detected orphan anchor 'autoscale-rules' after sitemap scan.

sam: i can pick this up if alice is out. is it just the anchor id changed or whole section moved?

alice: thanks. moved that section into 'deployment-policies' last month and forgot to add redirect. my bad 🙈

maria: okay team — quick plan: alice to open PR with 301 redirect or re-add anchor, + add CODEOWNER? sam offered to review. timeline: today if possible.

alice: opening PR now. sed fix I use locally:
```bash
rg -l "#autoscale-rules" -g "**/*.md" | xargs sed -i "s/#autoscale-rules/#deployment-policies-autoscale/"
```

sam: I'll review within an hour. can we also add a tiny test to the docs CI to catch dead anchors? cc @dan for CI heads-up

dan: we have a link-checker job — I can add anchor checks to the job tomorrow. low risk. :+1:

sam: sounds good. alice pls add a changelog line so we can track.

alice: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4827 — small redirect + test + changelog. assign @sam @maria for review

maria: thx! merging after sam lgtm. can someone add the owner to the page frontmatter so future pings don't hit the whole team?

alice: done in PR. frontmatter now has owner: alice

sam: LGTM, merging now. nice fast turnaround :rocket:
